<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Golden character in motion</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:white}
svg{display:block}

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",()=>{
const el=id=>document.getElementById(id),ns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
function node(tag,parent,attrs){
 const n=document.createElementNS(ns,tag);
 for(const k in attrs)n.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);
 parent.appendChild(n);
 return n;
}
const arms=["left","right"].map(name=>{
 const group=node("g",el("arms-behind"),{id:name+"-arm"});
 const tube=node("path",group,{fill:"url(#armGold)"});
 const hand=node("g",group,{id:name+"-hand",fill:"url(#handColor)"});
 const fingers=node("use",hand,{href:"#fingers"});
 const palm=node("use",hand,{href:"#palm"});
 return {group,tube,hand,fingers,palm};
});
const times=[0,800,1530,2330,3130,3930,4670,5470,5540];
const bodies=[
[101,18,121,28,126,56,138,85,150,132,157,180,140,216,126,229,98,232,68,219,51,191,43,160,50,113,55,80,73,50,84,28],

[89,31,106,37,114,60,127,91,142,128,149,175,140,205,123,222,94,232,65,224,43,202,34,174,39,131,49,94,61,63,72,40],
[115,-26,140,-16,151,21,169,68,183,121,194,195,183,238,160,268,113,278,57,264,32,233,25,193,37,148,46,80,74,45,88,2],
[91,11,110,19,119,46,136,76,151,123,166,173,155,212,135,238,101,246,66,237,42,213,31,181,37,133,45,87,61,56,73,23],
[105,21,125,28,143,55,157,84,172,128,175,177,163,202,142,225,116,231,91,218,69,198,56,169,58,127,74,88,88,66,82,39],
[108,22,129,29,149,55,167,83,181,125,197,178,187,207,165,232,137,241,107,228,84,208,69,177,68,141,81,99,90,67,86,41],
[99,19,120,24,143,49,163,78,184,118,196,164,190,198,170,224,144,233,111,225,85,208,69,180,67,145,77,108,84,76,76,47]
];
const face=[
[101,18,1,1,-9,18,13,18,.13,1,2,30,20,2],
[76,44,.96,.92,-10,20,20,17,1,.82,8,32,19,4],
[91,31,.96,1,-17,23,15,25,1,.86,-3,37,17,5],
[116,-26,1.32,1.32,-19,28,13,27,.98,1,-2,40,20,-3],
[92,11,1,1,-20,27,16,24,1,.9,-5,41,22,4],
[104,21,.78,.94,-25,18,-27,18,.85,0,-25,38,6,1],
[107,22,.79,.95,-25,18,-27,18,.85,0,-24,39,6,1],
[98,19,.8,.98,-25,22,-27,22,.85,0,-23,40,6,1]

const bellies=[[101,154,.97,1],[70,166,.94,1],[91,161,.95,.92],[110,182,1.45,1.35],[98,159,1.12,1.05],[58,158,.69,1],[71,165,.7,1],[71,159,.72,1]];
const legs=[[84,242,1,0,120,242,1,0],[47,245,1,0,85,246,1,0],[77,243,.96,-6,118,241,.99,-8],[71,263,1.6,0,148,266,1.55,0],[79,245,1.16,0,126,245,1.09,0],[93,239,.7,-2,117,242,.9,7],[104,246,.88,-6,152,245,1,0],[111,241,.76,-3,133,243,.8,3]];
const left=[
[63,78,49,129,38,189,9,.94,0,.68],[45,96,42,146,84,82,-133,.78,.85,1],[54,96,53,153,56,112,157,.86,.31,.87],[58,76,41,173,13,197,59,1.3,.55,1.25],[53,86,51,144,71,107,-127,1.17,.04,1],[104,82,53,121,43,52,194,.83,1,1],[109,84,62,128,42,77,164,.76,.85,1],[105,91,129,152,155,224,-36,.93,.16,1]];
const right=[
[132,79,145,136,158,197,-9,.94,0,.65],[96,92,112,126,101,82,153,.79,.85,.86],[119,92,152,140,174,130,-65,.85,.87,.88],[164,81,176,150,185,219,-14,.65,.45,.85],[133,82,146,144,162,213,-18,.93,.15,.8],[89,80,48,105,17,85,107,.85,.55,.75],[94,85,55,117,18,94,107,.83,.49,.8],[116,88,144,157,168,220,-30,.72,.5,.7]];
function curve(p){
 let s="M"+p[0]+" "+p[1],n=p.length/2;
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++){
  const a=(j+n-1)%n*2,b=j*2,c=(j+1)%n*2,d=(j+2)%n*2;
  s+=`C${p[b]+(p[c]-p[a])/6} ${p[b+1]+(p[c+1]-p[a+1])/6} ${p[c]-(p[d]-p[b])/6} ${p[c+1]-(p[d+1]-p[b+1])/6} ${p[c]} ${p[c+1]}`;
 }
 return s+"Z";
}
function transform(id,v){el(id).setAttribute("transform",v)}
function render(t){
 t=((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
 let i=0;
 while(times[i+1]<=t)i++;
 const j=(i+1)%8;
 let u=(t-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);
 u=u*u*(3-2*u);
 const mix=arr=>arr[i].map((v,k)=>v+(arr[j][k]-v)*u);
 el("outline").setAttribute("d",curve(mix(bodies)));
 const [x,y,w,h]=mix(bellies);
 transform("belly-position",`translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${w} ${h})`);
 const [hx,hy,sx,sy,lx,ly,rx,ry,open,vis,mx,my,mw,bend]=mix(face);
 transform("head",`translate(${hx} ${hy}) scale(${sx} ${sy})`);
 [0,1].forEach(k=>{
  const e=el(k?"right-eye":"left-eye").firstElementChild;
  const attrs={cx:k?rx:lx,cy:k?ry:ly,rx:k?4.8*vis:4.85,ry:1+4.6*open,opacity:.17+.83*open};
  for(const key in attrs)e.setAttribute(key,attrs[key]);
 });
 el("smile").setAttribute("d",`M${mx-mw/2} ${my}q${mw*.45} ${bend} ${mw} -.5`);
 const lg=mix(legs);
 ["left-leg","right-leg"].forEach((id,k)=>{
  const [a,b,c,r]=lg.slice(k*4);
  transform(id,`translate(${a} ${b}) rotate(${r}) scale(${c} 1.12)`);
 });
 arms.forEach((a,k)=>{
  const [ax,ay,ex,ey,wx,wy,ang,size,curl,th]=mix(k?right:left);
  const near=u<.5?i:j;
  el((near===0||(k===1&&near>=3)||near===3)?"arms-behind":"arms-in-front").appendChild(a.group);
  const centers=[],radii=[];
  for(let n=0;n<=24;n++){
   const z=n/24,f=1-z;
   const midx=(ax+wx)/2,midy=(ay+wy)/2,bulge=1-Math.sqrt((2*z-1)**2+.0225)/Math.sqrt(1.0225);
   centers.push([ax*f+wx*z+(ex-midx)*bulge,ay*f+wy*z+(ey-midy)*bulge]);
   radii.push(th*(11*(1-z)+4.3*z+3*Math.sin(z*Math.PI)));
  }
  const edges=[[],[]];
  centers.forEach(([px,py],n)=>{
   const prev=centers[Math.max(0,n-1)],next=centers[Math.min(24,n+1)];
   const dx=next[0]-prev[0],dy=next[1]-prev[1],r=radii[n]/(Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1);
   edges[0].push([px-dy*r,py+dx*r]);
   edges[1].push([px+dy*r,py-dx*r]);
  });
  a.tube.setAttribute("d","M"+edges[0].concat(edges[1].reverse()).map(p=>p.join(" ")).join("L")+"Z");
  a.hand.setAttribute("transform",`translate(${wx} ${wy}) rotate(${ang}) scale(${size})`);
  a.fingers.setAttribute("transform",`scale(1 ${1-.53*curl})`);
  a.palm.setAttribute("opacity",curl);
 });
}
window.nwb={render};
render(0);
});
</script>
</head>
